scope: Independent source execution; no all.lua dump/undump roundtrip, shared-state ordering, or final global cleanup. _soft is not enabled.

cases.reason: Upstream orchestrator. This profile expands its source entries independently; its dump/undump wrapper, shared state, and final cleanup require a separate full-suite lane.
The entire file returns immediately without the upstream TestC T module. Stock Lua 5.1.5 and lua_rust do not provide that private C-test API.
Package loading, module environments, globals, assignment order; requires a writable libs directory.
partial_exclusions: Native libs/lib1.so and libs/lib2.so are not in the vendored inventory; the upstream file reports and skips their load tests.

cases.reason: Starts with a 32 MiB string concatenated 129 times, requiring a >4 GiB overflow attempt tied to upstream string-size limits, before coroutine yields b/a. Needs a separately budgeted overflow/coroutine lane; _soft does not skip this allocation.
Lua/C calls, tail calls, readers, dump/undump, and upvalues.
require helper defining stat; without TestC it installs a diagnostic fallback. It has no standalone assertion workload.
Closures, environments, coroutines and debug API.
partial_exclusions: The upstream if-not-T branch skips private C yield/hook tests.

cases.reason: The entire file requires T.listcode and otherwise returns immediately. Existing bytecode parity tools cover separate opcode contracts; they are not execution of this file's assertions.
Expression precedence, branches, loops and generated source.
Debug source/line/frame/local/upvalue/hook contracts.
Parser/runtime error messages and protected-call contracts.
Metamethods including newproxy and primitive type metatables.
File handles, binary I/O, errno, pipes, date/time and locale; fresh working directory and redirected stdin.
partial_exclusions: Upstream conditionally skips unavailable popen support; emitted skip messages are preserved.

cases.reason: Full GC workload, including 200000-node structures and finalizers; no _soft shortcut.
Byte literals, long strings, lexer and numeric parsing.
partial_exclusions: Upstream conditionally skips pt_BR/ptb decimal-locale tests when unavailable; emitted skip messages are preserved.

cases.reason: Local scopes, environments and lexical blocks.
partial_exclusions: The optional querytab block cannot run without private GC/table instrumentation.

cases.reason: CLI subprocess/argument/interactive/stdio contracts. Runs unchanged so host shell or stock-oracle failures remain visible.
Full math, numeric strings, NaN and random workload; requires checktable.lua and writable temporary files. _soft is unset.
Tables, next, length and iteration.
partial_exclusions: The if-T block tests private table sizing and int2fb and is unavailable without TestC.

cases.reason: String patterns, matching and replacements.
Full 30000-element sort workload; _soft is unset.
Byte strings, format, coercion and string operators.
Varargs, legacy arg table and multireturn.
Generates and executes a >64k program and 70001-field table; requires checktable.lua and writable files. _soft is unset.
